title:
A compound DFE is one that embeds multiple distinct results (different {@link DataFlowEvent}) together.
The Compound Data Flow Event maintains each independent DFE as fields on the compound DFE type and can be feed
as a single input to an {@link Analytic}. Often referred to as “Compound DFE”

   A compound DFE must be declared with {@ Ann.DFE} annotation to specify the time nature of data to be generated.
All embedded DFEs included in a compound dfe should have same source type and have same value for {@link Ann.DFE}.interval
and {@link Ann.DFE}.period
e.g
```
  @dfe(period="DAY", interval="DAY", metric="Temperature")
  type SmartBulbTemperature mixes TSDataFlowEvent<SmartBulb>

  @dfe(period="DAY", interval="DAY", metric="OperationHours")
  type SmartBulbAvailability mixes TSDataFlowEvent<SmartBulb>

  @dfe(period="DAY", interval="DAY)
  type SmartBulbOverheatInput mixes CompoundDataFlowEvent<SmartBulb> {
    temperature: SmartBulTemperature
    availability: SmartBulbAvailability
  }
 ```
